summary: Foresight Autonomous Holdings Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq, filed a routine Form 6-K on October 20, 2026, merely to furnish an updated corporate presentation (Exhibit 99.1) posted to its website, signed by CFO Eli Yoresh. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or regulatory clock is disclosed. The filing is an ordinary investor-relations disclosure with no US equivalent special-situation event; it is neither a merger proxy, tender offer solicitation, nor a strategic-review announcement. Watch for any subsequent 6-K disclosing capital raises or partnerships, as the presentation itself carries no deal terms.
